_comment: The functions-only site of docs/ACCOUNTS-PLAN.md §2, §13.1, §13.8 (D19). Host-neutral description used by server/site/build.js and checked by the tests; the owner maps it to the host's own settings once (server/RUNBOOK.md, Activation checklist). It lives in server/ on purpose: the repository root carries no host configuration, so the static site keeps deploying exactly as v3.4.
name: wts-accounts-api

schedules.name: ops-daily
schedules.how: POST /api/v1/ops/daily signed with WTS_OPS_HMAC (server/ops/call-daily.js) — or the host scheduler invoking the same

schedules.name: weekly-export
schedules.how: node server/ops/weekly-export.js (jobs host or the owner's machine; never from the static site)

rewrite._comment: Configured on the STATIC site by the owner (host settings or the generated publish directory), never in this repository's root.

addRequestHeaders.X-WTS-Proxy-Sig: <the current value of WTS_PROXY_SIG — set in the host, never committed>
